def SmallGammaGeodesics.maxDev : C(↑unitInterval, ℂ) → ℝ :=
fun η => ⨆ t, Metric.infDist (η t) (segment ℝ 0 1)
def SmallGammaGeodesics.rescaledPath : ℝ → C(↑unitInterval, ℂ) → C(↑unitInterval, ℂ) :=
fun s η => { toFun := fun t => (η t - ↑↑t) / ↑s, continuous_toFun := ⋯ }
def SmallGammaGeodesics.horizDev : ℝ → C(↑unitInterval, ℂ) → ℝ :=
fun s η => ⨆ t, |(η t).re - ↑t| / s
